verdict.rationale: A community connector or integration ecosystem is a fair question for a workflow orchestration platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no mechanism or catalog for installing community-built components contributed outside the vendor. The Google ADK and Vercel AI SDK integrations appear as first-party SDK docs, not community contributions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
